<script>
  class {
    PROPS = {
      label: { type: String, default: 'Count' },
      start: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    }

    init(props) {
      this.state.count = props.start
    }

    increment() {
      this.state.count++
    }
  }
</script>

<button onclick="fez.increment()">
  {props.label}: {state.count}
</button>

<score-counter label="Points" start="10"></score-counter>
